record.body:
## Rationale

A route to execute or verify is the loop continuing on its own; an upstream route, a block, or low confidence is where a person decides.

## Counter-argument

Every failure surfacing means nothing goes unnoticed when the agent stalls on a repeated implementation failure.

payload.alternatives: Also every failed or insufficient assessment
payload.choice: Needs you shows latest assessments that route to specify, design, or plan, are blocked, or have low confidence, and failed or blocked integration-reports
